database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Owner approved dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). Direct Console plan and $0 invoice were last confirmed 5 November; current billing cannot be refreshed through CLI. At 04:20 UTC Prisma CLI measured 7,890 Production operations. The sum of all 9 databases across five enumerated projects is 33,606 operations, a derived estimate rather than the direct Console workspace meter. The Production backup inventory at 04:20 UTC showed no listed backups (zero retention). Production database is ready and lists five credential records, but per-credential health is unavailable. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; Free has no automatic backups, and recurring backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-06 04:20 UTC derived workspace sum of 33,606/200,000, about 166,394 operations remained. Based only on the one-operation room-poll estimate, this supports about 346 two-hour two-player sessions (480 room polls each) or 173 four-player sessions (960 room polls each) before all other queries. Two tabs polling continuously every 30 seconds would add 172,800 operations/month, leaving about 6,394 operations for all other use; four tabs would add 345,600. Presence adds about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session. These are source-based estimates, not measured polling traffic or capacity acceptance.
